name: Park method
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中用于列车—轨道子系统的隐式时间积分方法。
usage_overview: 用于列车—轨道及下部结构动力方程的隐式时间积分，通过多个历史时刻的状态求取新时刻响应，可处理非对角质量矩阵系统，也用作其他积分方法验证的比较基准。

complete_examples.text: The train–track system is solved by implicitly Park method.
With consistent mass assumption, the soil responses can be solved by the Park method as illustrated in Example 1.
Under these conditions, the calculation time using GPIM was 306 min, while the calculation time using the park method was 391 min.

(Validation for the GPIM) It should be noted that the TTTS physical model employs the finite element method as described in Ref. [27], while the control group uses the Park method, also detailed in Ref. [27].
It should be noted that the responses of the substructural systems can also be obtained by implicit integration method such as Park method, where Eqs. (19)–(23) can be similarly applied.
